tweets.text:
AI Made Building Easy. Now Investors Want Proof You Can Scale. 

Vibe coding and AI are changing the way investors look at startups.

If before, having a technical edge was a huge differentiator (it still is for more complex infrastructure projects). now anyone can spin up an app or platform in days, sometimes even hours. The barrier to building has dropped, which creates incredible opportunities for non-technical founders.

But this shift also means one thing: execution matters more than ever.

Green flags for investors are no longer just about the tech. They’re about how you scale.
✔️ Early partnerships you’ve secured
✔️ LOIs signed with potential clients
✔️ Users on your waitlist or already testing your product
✔️ Early revenue, even if small

These are the signals that show product-market fit and prove you’re the right person to execute.

Technology is easier to build than ever. The real question is: can you scale it?

tweets.text:
Introducing user login for vibe-coded business apps

We rebuilt it three times to get it right, here’s why:

Zite's target customers are business users, not founders building the latest SaaS.

This presents two challenges for vibe coding:

1. Business data lives in existing systems of record (like Airtable, Salesforce)

2. Security can’t be based on vibes or reading AI generated code

💡 Our approach

First, your database is the source of truth. No duplicate user data.

Second, backend workflows are secured by default. We don't rely on AI to protect endpoints.

Lastly, backend logic and permissions are observable and editable (like n8n or Zapier).

You choose whether your app is internal, invite only or open for signups.

Login is live for everyone in @zitehq starting today.

And the best part:

There's no user limits.

Happy building!

Think about that.

You describe what you want → walk away → come back 3+ hours later to a working app.

No "fix this bug" prompts. No hand-holding. No babysitting.

It just... builds.

But here's the crazy part.

It opens a browser and tests its own code like a real user.

You can watch it clicking around your app, finding bugs, fixing them automatically.

It's 3X faster and 10X more powerful (thanks to the autonomous feature) than other AI testing tools.

I'm watching an AI debug itself. In 2025. Wild.

Then it gets meta.

Agent 3 builds other agents.

Want a Slack bot that queries your database? Built.
Need a Telegram bot for habit tracking? Done.
Daily email summaries of your stock portfolio? Deployed.

You're not just building apps anymore. You're building an AI workforce.

The shift is real:

From AI helper → to AI teammate From prompt engineer → to project manager From debugging sessions → to reviewing results From weekend coding → to Monday morning deploys

Look, I've seen every AI assistant and vibe coding tool under the sun.

Most are just great at prototyping but as features get complex.. they become harder to navigate. They cost you hours in debugging and bug fixes.

Agent 3 feels fundamentally different.

It doesn't just write code better. It works better.

And you can monitor the whole thing from your phone while it builds.

What an exciting move from Replit to push the envelope of vibe coding tools!
